AgentEntry.description:
One entry of `agents:`. Every key is optional, because a layer may change the built-in entry field by field
(0.7); a file's entry for any other id must name its `kind` ([`SettingsError::MissingKind`]).

args.description: An ACP agent's arguments. `--mdns`, `--cors` and a `--hostname` that is not loopback are refused.

budget_usd.description: An optional cap on the spend of one ask. Claude Code only.

command.description: The program an ACP agent starts. Required for `kind: acp`.

config.description: Which Claude settings the agent tool reads: `none`, or `user` for "use my Claude config" (0.3).

env.description:
Environment for the child. A literal value under a name that ends in `KEY`, `TOKEN`, `SECRET` or
`PASSWORD` is refused: use `secrets`.

model.description: A model name for Claude Code (`haiku`), or an opaque id for ACP (`ollama/qwen2.5:7b`, 0.3).

read.description: Folders it may read. `<board root>` stands for the board's default line root.

secrets.description: Environment variable to the name of an item in the OS keychain. A reference, never a value.

timeout_s.description: Collide's timeout for one ask, in seconds: 5 to 1800.

AgentKind.description: What an agent runs as. The variants carry plain comments, not doc comments, so the schema stays a bare enum.

Ask.description:
`ask:`. `agent` names the entry the ask box uses. `budget_usd` and `timeout_s` are the defaults for every
ask, and the only keys a repo file may set here.

ClaudeSettings.description: `claude:`. `check_published` turns the fetch of the published `claude` version off (0.3). A per-user key.

DiskSettings.description: `disk:`. `floor_gib` is the free space under which Collide pauses runs, in GiB.

RoleConfig.description: `config: user | none`: which settings the agent tool reads (0.3, Context options).

ToolKind.description: A tool kind an agent may use. v0 accepts only these two: any other kind is a load error that names the key.

UiToolsSettings.description:
`ui_tools:`. `port` is the loopback port of the UI-tools endpoint (0.2). The app picks it on its first start and
keeps it here, so a client's snippet stays right. A per-user key.

agents.description: One entry per agent id. Only the user's file may hold these (0.7).

config.description:
Pack settings: pack name, then key, then value. A pack's schema checks each value (Stage 4a), and a key
the pack marks `secret: true` is refused here ([`secrets_in_file`]).
